title: Self-Pay Visit Package Reinstatement Fee by Days Since Expiry
content:
**Fee schedule — reinstatement fee by lapse, Self-Pay Visit Package.** The reinstatement fee is charged at a lapse percentage that follows the calendar days from the expiry date on file to the reinstatement date: **50 percent** of the fee where those days are no more than **7**, **150 percent** where they are **15** or more. From 8 to 14 days no lapse percentage applies.

**Counting the days.** The days are the calendar days from the expiry date recorded on the package to the reinstatement date, the expiry date itself being day 0.

| Calendar days from the expiry date on file to the reinstatement | Lapse percentage of the fee |
|---|---|
| 0 to 7 | 50 percent |
| 8 to 14 | none applies |
| 15 or more | 150 percent |

**Boundary days**

- Day 7: 50 percent — the boundary day qualifies.
- Day 8: no lapse percentage.
- Day 14: no lapse percentage.
- Day 15: 150 percent — the boundary day qualifies.

**Hypothetical figures.** The percentage applies to the tier's reinstatement fee itself and is not rounded on its own: a fee of $35.00 charged at 50 percent is $17.50 and at 150 percent is $52.50; a fee of $50.00 is $25.00 and $75.00 respectively.
